camel_example: aliyun polardb DescribeDBClustersWithBackups --region cn-hangzhou --IsDeleted 0 --DBVersion '8.0' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-000000000000' --PageSize 30 --DBClusterIds 'pc-00000000000000' --PageNumber 1 --DBClusterDescription test --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DBType MySQL
description_en: Queries PolarDB clusters in a region that have backup sets
description_zh: 查询某地域下包含备份集的PolarDB集群详情
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-db-clusters-with-backups --resource-group-id rg-000000000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-ids pc-00000000000000 --db-cluster-description test --db-type MySQL --is-deleted 0 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --db-version 8.0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClustersWithBackups

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to view details about regions
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
可通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html查看地域信息详情
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cluster. You can specify multiple cluster IDs. Separate the IDs with a comma (,)
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID，支持传入多个集群ID，集群ID之间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: db_cluster_ids

parameters.help_en:
The cluster name. The cluster name must meet the following requirements:

It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

It must be 2 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
集群名称，集群名称需满足如下要求：
不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
长度为2~256个字符
parameters.name: db_cluster_description

parameters.help_en:
The database engine type. Valid values:

MySQL

PostgreSQL

Oracle
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎类型，取值范围如下： 
MySQL
PostgreSQL
Oracle
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the cluster is deleted. Valid values:

0: The cluster is not deleted.

1: The cluster is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
集群是否已删除，取值范围如下：
0：未删除
1：已删除
parameters.name: is_deleted

parameters.help_en:
The number of records on each page. Valid values:

30

50

100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值范围如下：
30
50
100

默认值为30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值范围为大于0但不超过Integer最大值的整数，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The database engine version.

Valid values for MySQL:

5.6

5.7

8.0

Valid values for PostgreSQL:

11

14

Valid values for Oracle:

11

14
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎版本号。
MySQL版本号取值范围如下： 
    * 5.6
    * 5.7
    * 8.0
PostgreSQL版本号取值范围如下： 
    * 11
    * 14
Oracle版本号取值范围如下： 
    * 11
    * 14
parameters.name: db_version

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the cluster was created

DBClusterNetworkType.description_en: The network type of the cluster

DBClusterStatus.description_en:
The cluster status. Valid values:

Creating: The cluster is being created.

Running: The cluster is running.

Deleting: The cluster is being released.

Rebooting: The cluster is restarting.

DBNodeCreating: Nodes are being added.

DBNodeDeleting: Nodes are being deleted.

ClassChanging: The node specifications are being changed.

NetAddressCreating: A network connection is being created.

NetAddressDeleting: A network connection is being deleted.

NetAddressModifying: A network connection is being modified.

Deleted: The cluster is released
DBClusterStatus.description_zh:
集群状态，取值范围如下：
Creating：创建中
Running：运行中
Deleting：释放中
Rebooting：重启中
DBNodeCreating：正在增加节点
DBNodeDeleting：正在删除节点
ClassChanging：正在变更节点规格
NetAddressCreating：正在创建网络连接
NetAddressDeleting：正在删除网络连接
NetAddressModifying：正在修改网络连接 
Deleted：已释放

DBType.description_en: The type of the database engine

DBVersion.description_en: The version of the database engine

DeletedTime.description_en: The time when the cluster was deleted

DeletionLock.description_en:
The deletion lock status of the cluster. Valid values:

0: The cluster is not locked and can be deleted.

1: The cluster is locked and cannot be deleted
DeletionLock.description_zh:
集群删除的锁定状态，取值范围如下：
0：未锁定，可删除集群。
1：锁定，不可删除集群

ExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration time.

This parameter is returned only for subscription clusters. An empty string is returned for pay-as-you-go clusters
ExpireTime.description_zh:
到期时间。
仅付费方式为Prepaid（包年包月）的集群会返回具体参数值，Postpaid（按量付费）集群则返回空值

Expired.description_en:
Indicates whether the cluster has expired.

This parameter is returned only for subscription clusters
Expired.description_zh:
集群是否过期。
仅付费方式为Prepaid（包年包月）的集群支持返该参数

IsDeleted.description_en:
Indicates whether the cluster is released. Valid values:

1: The cluster is released.

0: The cluster is not released
IsDeleted.description_zh:
集群是否已释放，取值范围如下：
1：已释放。
0：未释放

LockMode.description_en:
The lock state of the cluster. Valid values:

Unlock: The cluster is not locked.

ManualLock: The cluster is manually locked.

LockByExpiration: The cluster is automatically locked due to expiration
LockMode.description_zh:
集群的锁定状态，取值范围如下： 
Unlock：正常
ManualLock：手动触发锁定
LockByExpiration：集群过期自动锁定

PayType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.

Prepaid: subscription
PayType.description_zh:
付费类型，取值范围如下：
Postpaid：按量付费。
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）。

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC)

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of clusters on the current page

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
